changelog: One compact CS3M Updater across settings, with installed/latest versions and readable release notes.
Release warnings appear in separate ATTENTION blocks; long release notes remain scrollable.
Clear checking, download, verification and installation progress with retryable errors.
Manual updates let you choose when to restart CloudStream after verified installation.
Cached results are labelled; release metadata and available SHA-256 checksums must match the selected version.
ATTENTION: Update through the dcext repository in CloudStream or the built-in CS3M Updater. No manual plugin-file import is needed.
